Q5738.reason: Mixed goods and services contracts fall under the UCC unless the services are the predominant purpose, so Connie wins under the UCC unless the service agreement predominates.

Q5278.reason: Burglary requires intent to commit a felony at the time of entry, and he entered only to enjoy the party and formed the intent to steal later.

Q8324.reason: The drug-seeking, agitated presentation fits addiction, where chronic use downregulates post-synaptic dopamine receptors.
